verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit least-privilege controls: locking an API key to specific formats/endpoints (server-enforced, no override), IP allowlisting for team keys, and org-wide URL blocking policy, plus audit event streaming — directly matching the scoped-credential story for agent use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these key-scoping features in practice and clearer documentation of role-based or read/write-level scoping beyond endpoint/format locks.
